text:
Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence where
systems learn patterns from data.

Overfitting happens when a model learns the training data too
closely and performs poorly on unseen data.

Underfitting happens when a model is too simple to capture
important patterns in the data.
A training set is used to learn model parameters.
A validation set is used to evaluate the model during development.
A test set is used to evaluate the final model on unseen data.
Unsupervised learning works with data without target labels.

A neural network consists of interconnected computational units
called neurons.
A perceptron is a simple artificial neuron.
Deep neural networks contain multiple layers.

An activation function introduces non-linearity into a neural
network.
Common activation functions include ReLU, sigmoid, and tanh.

A convolutional neural network is commonly used for image
processing and computer vision.

Python is a high-level programming language commonly used in
automation, data science, machine learning, and web development.
A list is an ordered mutable collection.
A tuple is an ordered immutable collection.
A dictionary stores data as key-value pairs.
A function is a reusable block of code that performs a task.
